description: This Mendeley Data collection delineates agricultural field polygons across Alberta, Saskatchewan and Manitoba. Researchers processed Sentinel-2 seasonal composites with a Segment Anything Model 2 workflow and assembled approximately 656,082 field polygons. The current version 2 inventory lists 463 public files, including regional GeoParquet pieces and shapefile archives, under CC BY 4.0. The article describes a Prairie-wide dataset intended to support crop and land-management analysis. Coverage is delineated field extents in three provinces, not crop yields, irrigation pipes or verified legal parcel boundaries. Automated segmentation, cloud masking and the satellite-image period are limitations when interpreting small or changing fields. A reviewer-assessed use is allocating crop or irrigation demand to field units in regional simulations. platform-global-food-twin is a related food-system resource, but no direct ingestion or boundary matching was tested. The article cited version 1, while the repository exposes version 2. No polygon files, imagery or code were downloaded.
name: Canadian Prairies SAM2-derived agricultural field boundaries
